source_findings.finding: There is one subprocess callsite and exactly three sequential callers: cat-file commit HEAD, ls-tree -r -z HEAD, and cat-file --batch. The final stdin is generated only from distinct validated lowercase 40-hex workflow blob IDs; at most 64 IDs yield 2624 bytes, with zero IDs still invoking the third builtin on EOF. No request-supplied argv, shell, retry, fallback query, checkout, stage, ref/config write, fetch, push, build or cleanup callsite exists. Fixed cwd/GIT_DIR target only the adopted fresh clone. Clean child environment plus no-pager/no-optional-locks, disabled lazy fetch/replacements/global-system configuration, denied protocols and helper exec-path, and raw builtins without filters/textconv support the cooperative no-helper claim. This is not an adversarial repository-configuration/custody or host-wide nonaccess proof.

Handlers latch INT/TERM/HUP before launch; direct-child pidfd is captured before wait/reap. Nonempty stdin gets a single nonblocking PIPE_BUF-checked write and original-writer close even on pidfd failure. Original stdout/stderr are read nonblocking; waitid(P_PIDFD,WEXITED|WNOHANG|WNOWAIT) does not prematurely release identity. Success requires both observed EOFs and own-child wait status0, with no errors/cancellation. TERM/KILL address only the original pidfd, never a numeric PID/group. Final close/wait is bounded; no next command follows a failed child. Failed pidfd capture cannot claim settlement or authorize cleanup; it can leave an explicitly unknown original child for root disposition. Exact builtin/no-competing-reaper custody is a genuine root precondition, not inferred from a scan.

The original requested phase is positive and at most90s, includes entry, and cannot be extended; work ends18s before its deadline and each command has at most20s. Four exact already-inherited finite rlimit pairs are mandatory, including CORE0, AS<=2GiB, FSIZE<=4MiB and CPU<=90s, without setrlimit. Bounded meminfo sampling records current/min available and total, enforcing12GiB AND25% at entry and8GiB AND20% while running. Original directory FDs supply current/min free-byte samples, always requiring3GiB. The final seal fixes both literal coordinator-parent path and [23,534,0,448], opens it no-follow, then opens/checks/locks the coordinator leaf relative to that FD and rechecks both bindings. Fresh root admission must still supply the original leaf's full pin, sufficient inherited limits and actual current resources.

Raw commit bytes are SHA1 Git-object framed and must equal expected HEAD832ed5f5aee56fbbf4c298ef0d2b10de154484cf, with the sole declared tree24d4157fff0d5fcc5cb694e598f21f561d1921d4. Complete NUL-delimited recursive leaves are validated for canonical admitted mode/type/OID and path components; duplicate/prefix collisions fail. Recursive reconstruction uses Git directory-versus-leaf sorting, 40000 tree modes and raw20-byte OIDs, requiring the expected root hash. Every blob leaf below literal .github/workflows/ retains its path/mode/OID association; batch OIDs alone are deduplicated. Each exact OID/blob header, body length, body object ID, delimiter and final byte offset is checked. Workflow body SHA256 and offsets point into retained raw batch output. No YAML or hosting/PR policy interpretation is claimed.

Overall/per-command intents, all six raw streams, compact metadata and final record share one4MiB aggregate payload budget with64KiB final reserve. Full parsed-tree duplication is removed: metadata keeps expected root, leaf count and exact raw-tree descriptor; workflow associations and body offsets remain. Writes are fixed-name exclusive/no-follow root0600, fsynced and retained; admission must finish before any result write. Read/write/cap failures remain unsuccessful even if partial files exist. RESULT is explicitly preterminal. Post-result guards and FD-close errors affect terminal success; after FD closure DONE makes later handled cancellation exit nonzero, including during terminal printing. Actual terminal0, fully settled terminal streams and error/signal-free final receipt remain mandatory, not inferred from RESULT.

limitations_and_root_conditions: This is source acceptance only. The unbound null/false template is neither a runnable instance nor genuine execution authority. Root must bind/check exact source, public tools, original coordinator, private empty evidence, no-overlap/no-reaper custody, inherited limits and fresh original phase before one launch.

No source review can authenticate the request's independent-review hash or custody booleans. Root's separate admission and original tool result are required; old phase, store, query or clone slots are not revived.

Unsupported modes, invisible empty subtrees, excessive/deep trees, nonblob/non-UTF8 workflow paths, excess unique workflow IDs, output caps or unavailable originals can conservatively refuse; none permits a fourth command or replay.

Resource samples are observations, not reservations; cooperative polling does not bound an OS/filesystem stall in hard real time. Original terminal chronology must establish the admitted <=90s phase; an overrun or unknown terminal remains unaccepted.

Root actual review must independently rehash complete retained raw streams, reconcile all three pidfd/reap/EOF/exit0 rows and final receipt, reconstruct the commit/tree/workflow joins, and then inspect the captured workflow trigger content. Metadata alone does not establish safe CI/PR/publication, branch ancestry, current immutable refs, product correctness or a test pass.
